swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS610994DRVR uses WSON-6 (6-pin, DRV) while TPS613221ADBVR uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs SW), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (FB vs NC), Pin 4 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 5 (SW vs NC), Pin 6 (VIN vs NONE). Soldering TPS613221ADBVR onto a TPS610994DRVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (WSON-6: GND vs SOT-23-5: NONE); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 30% (TPS610994DRVR: 1116 kHz p.16 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 1600 kHz p.9); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 62% (TPS610994DRVR: 71.7 °C/W p.4 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 189.7 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: TPS610994DRVR (Texas Instruments, WSON-6) and TPS613221ADBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs SW), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (FB vs NC), Pin 4 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 5 (SW vs NC), Pin 6 (VIN vs NONE); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Key datasheet deltas: topology is boost (sync) vs boost (sync), switching frequency is 1116 kHz (p.16) vs 1600 kHz (p.9), rated current is 1000 mA (p.5) vs 1200 mA (p.5), typical inductor is 2.2 µH (p.4) vs 2.2 µH (p.4), and Iq is 1 µA (p.5) vs 6.5 µA (p.5). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 71.7 vs 189.7 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
